# 🚀 Static Website Release Checklist

- [ ] Correct branch and commit selected.
- [ ] README, changelog, and docs updated.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data included.
- [ ] Root `index.html` serves successfully.
- [ ] CSS, JS, and image references resolve with exact case.
- [ ] Navbar and carousel work.
- [ ] Keyboard focus and mobile layout reviewed.
- [ ] Branch details and menu copy verified.
- [ ] Testimonials are authentic and approved.
- [ ] Image and font rights reviewed.
- [ ] Contact form behavior accurately described.
- [ ] CDN versions and external resources reviewed.
- [ ] Static publish directory is repository root.
- [ ] HTTPS and domain configuration verified.
- [ ] Rollback path documented.
